name: FOOD INTOLERANCE - COMPREHENSIVE
interpretation:
Concentration of IgG in IU/ml Class Level of The specific IgG
<1.0 0 Cilinically insignificant
1.0 - 2.0 0-1 Low
> 2.0 - 3.3 1 Medium
> 3.5 >1 High

 

1. Results need to be correlated clinically.                
2. Food intolerance is IgG mediated hypersensitivity, so-called Type II and Typer III reaction.            
3. Definition and quantitative measurement of allergen-specific IgG concentrations have a great importance for diagnosis and investigation of food intolerance reactions for the selection of adequate therapy; for differentiation of some types of allergies in combination with other methods can be used to control the effectiveness of allergen-specific immunotherapy.

data.value:
Sample Type: Serum
Technique :  Solid-phase enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.
